questions.question: Who is currently second from bottom of the Premier League table today, Friday, 27th November 2026?
questions.clue: The 20-time English champions who play their home matches at Old Trafford.
questions.funFact: They sit 19th in the table on 8 points from their opening 11 fixtures, with just one league win so far this season.

questions.question: Bournemouth continued their European winning ways, winning 1-2 in Spain last night (Thursday); which team did they beat?
questions.clue: A Galician La Liga club that plays its home matches at Estadio Balaídos.
questions.funFact: Álvaro Rodríguez and Rayan struck for the Cherries at Balaídos to turn the match around and preserve their unbeaten European run.

questions.question: Brighton & Hove Albion also won last night (Thursday) against Universitatea Craiova; of what country were they league champions?
questions.clue: The Eastern European nation based around Bucharest and the Carpathian Mountains.
questions.funFact: Ibrahim Osman netted twice alongside goals from Maxim De Cuyper and Charalampos Kostoulas in a dominant 4–0 win for Brighton.

questions.question: Which London club also won in Europe last night?
questions.clue: A South London club famously nicknamed "The Eagles."
questions.funFact: Under manager Thomas Frank, the Eagles fought back to beat Real Sociedad 2–1 at Selhurst Park after a late winner.

questions.question: Which former Manchester City and Italy manager celebrates his birthday today, 27th November (62)?
questions.clue: The Italian coach who managed Manchester City from 2009 to 2013.
questions.funFact: Born on 27 November 1964, he famously guided Manchester City to their first Premier League title in 2012 before later winning UEFA Euro 2020 with Italy.

questions.question: What nationality is Chelsea midfielder Moisés Caicedo?
questions.clue: He hails from the South American country straddling the equator.
questions.funFact: Born in Santo Domingo, he represents La Tri on the international stage and has been a mainstay in Chelsea's midfield since arriving from Brighton.

questions.question: What shirt number does Moisés Caicedo wear for Chelsea?
questions.clue: An odd double-digit number equal to five squared (5×5).
questions.funFact: He took this squad number upon signing for Chelsea in August 2023.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has birthday boy Roberto Mancini won?
questions.clue: The single-digit number representing one top-flight title triumph.
questions.funFact: His solitary Premier League crown came in dramatic final-day fashion in May 2012 with Manchester City.

questions.question: Who is Chelsea’s top scorer (in all competitions) so far this season?
questions.clue: An attacking midfielder who wears the number 17 shirt for the Blues.
questions.funFact: He leads Chelsea's scoring charts across all competitions with 6 goals this season.

questions.question: What is the seating capacity of Brighton & Hove Albion’s stadium?
questions.clue: A five-digit number sitting halfway between 27,500 and 37,500.
questions.funFact: Opened in 2011 in Falmer, the Seagulls' home ground is commonly known as the Amex Stadium.
